newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee prices pushed up by limited quantity.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee prices pushed up by limited quantity.

text.p: Coffee prices were on average pushed up by $3 to $5 due to limited quantities on offer at the Kenyan auction on Tuesday, traders said on Wednesday.
Grade Cs averaged $139.5 per 50-kg (110.25 1b) bag from $127 last week, grade ABs rose to $146.5 from $141 and grade AAs eased marginally to $147.5 from $148 last week
"There were higher levels due to continued short coverings," a trader said, adding that there were two more auctions and with those all the 'fly coffee crop' should be sold.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 20,289, 60-kg bags it offered for sale versus 22,493 bags sold last week.
